elaine: Heads-up - FreshBite wants a 4-week on-prem POC in a sealed packing line. Requirements: fully air-gapped (no egress), physical media only (USB/courier), customer HSM (YubiHSM2), quarterly patch windows, signed SBOM, and chain-of-custody. Need feasibility, offline activation flow, and a rough POC quote.
omar: We support PKCS#11 userland signing flows. If they provide YubiHSM2 and an operator workstation inside the perimeter, we can do detached sig-request + operator sign + installer verify. No kernel modules required.
elainE: (typo fixed) viv: Quick sketch of operator flow:
```
# on CI: build bundle + manifest
rdwctl bundle create --model quant-rdw-7b --out fb-bundle.tar.gz --manifest manifest.json
rdwctl sig-request --manifest manifest.json > sigreq.bin
# operator signs inside airgap
hsm-sign --lib /usr/lib/libyubihsm.so --key-label fb-sign sigreq.bin > sig.bin
# installer verifies before apply
rdwctl verify --manifest manifest.json --sig sig.bin --pkcs11 /usr/lib/libyubihsm.so
```
elaine: Add chain-of-custody fields to manifest (seal_id, courier_name, courier_ts) and require operator checklist/signoff on apply.
omar: Patch cadence: quarterly cumulative bundles plus an emergency hotfix path via courier with pre-approved operator acceptance. Hotfix SLA: manual apply target <60m for POC if delta <1GB.
viv: Security: telemetry off by default, we can provide signed SBOM + attestation that no telemetry left nodes. If FreshBite needs FIPS we need to know scope (signing/TLS vs full runtime).
ops-bot: Created ticket RDW-9333: "FreshBite sealed-line POC - YubiHSM signing & courier" assigned to @omar. https://redwood.example/tickets/RDW-9333
elainE: I'll schedule a 30m presales + eng + security call with FreshBite tomorrow 11am PT. Omar/Viv: plz drop a short runbook, sample manifest, and SOW sketch (onboarding days + courier) in RDW-9333 before the call.
omar: Will add a lab sample and a ballpark POC quote (license + 3 eng days + courier) to the ticket.
viv: I'll start the SQ answers and list the FIPS Qs.
elainE: Thanks team
